state.misconception_label: Adds when calculating volume instead of multiplying

turn_history.speaker: student
turn_history.text: I have: The volume of this cuboid is \( 30 \mathrm{~cm}^{3} \) What length should replace the star? ![A cuboid, depth 2cm and height 3cm. The width is labelled with a star.](). I got \( 25 \mathrm{~cm} \) because I'm not sure I worked it out the right way.

turn_history.speaker: teacher
turn_history.text:

  2. Topic: Calculate the area of a rectangle where the dimensions are given in the same units. Correct answer (B): \( 40 \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \). Student selected: \( 13 \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \).   3. Topic: Perform calculations with areas when given in different units. Correct answer (C): \( 404 \mathrm{~mm}^{2} \). Student selected: \( 8 \mathrm{~mm}^{2} \). Underlying misconception: Does not convert measurements to have the same units before calculating area or volume.
